headline.text: Senior Backend Engineer | Laravel · Node.js/NestJS · REST APIs · MySQL/PostgreSQL | Scaled platforms to 5M+ monthly users on AWS | English C1 · UTC-6 (CST) · US remote

about:
Senior Backend Engineer with 12+ years building and scaling the APIs, data models, and architecture behind high-traffic consumer platforms. At Guatemala.com I led backend and platform engineering for a multi-brand media network — Guatemala.com, Noticias.com, Mundo.com, Hoteles.com, Autoweb, and Star Media properties — serving 5M+ monthly users, plus client project exposure to international brands such as Orange (Europe).

Core backend stack: PHP/Laravel and Node.js/NestJS, REST API design, MySQL and PostgreSQL, WordPress headless backends, AWS and Docker. I drove the migration from monolithic WordPress to headless WordPress + NestJS APIs on auto-scaling AWS, and owned ad systems, performance, and reliability across the network. When products need it, I also ship the frontend and mobile layers (React, Next.js, React Native/Ionic) — but backend architecture, data, and scalability are home base.

I practice AI-accelerated engineering daily — Claude, Codex, Gemini, Grok, and CLI agents as a genuine velocity multiplier, with the same review discipline and quality bar. English C1 (ELASH certified), based in Guatemala (UTC-6 / CST, full overlap with US business hours), remote since 2020. Open to US-remote Senior Backend Engineer and backend-leaning Senior Software Engineer roles — let's connect.
